name: Shoulder Pendulum

instructions.description: Support one hand on a chair and hinge slightly forward.
Let the other arm hang relaxed.
Use small body shifts to create gentle arm circles.
Reverse direction and then change arms.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record range only when measured consistently; do not force end range.

variations.variationDescription: Shoulder Pendulum — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Use small relaxed circles without adding weight.
